items.title: Weakly associated primes of a tensor product with a flat finitely presented module over a finitely presented ring map
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises the weakly associated primes of M tensor_R N, for a finite presentation R -> S and a finitely presented S-module N flat over R, as the primes lying over a weakly associated prime of M at which the fibre prime is associated to the fibre of N (statement lines 3749-3768, tag 05IG). The proof is long and genuinely reduction driven: an etale local model makes N projective over the base, the key observation on the associated primes of the fibre is extracted, the two forward implications are proved by universality of injectivity together with the fact that the localised module becomes a finite free direct summand, and the converse needs a five-condition reduction plus the determination of non injectivity of a map of projective modules over an auto-associated ring after tensoring with the residue field. That last step is not a routine citation, so the claim is H2.
